pairs.evidence: src/styles/themes.css:316 Light themes invert a fixed catalog of bg-white utilities to black rgba with !important, so those surfaces follow a class list instead of a rebound role and a new white-alpha utility stays uninverted until the catalog is extended.

techniques.evidence: src/lib/colors.ts:3 Hand-written RGB mirror of default --brand-cyan (#06b6d4) for canvas and inline styles; no generator, no getComputedStyle readback, and no test references BRAND_COLORS.

src/stores/themeStore.ts:108 The only persisted appearance choice is themeId. Searched these files and the repo for density, text-scale, font-scale, and prefers-contrast: no user axis rebinds spacing or type roles.

src/components/ThemeSwitcher.tsx:174 Tooltip motion inlines 150ms and a curve-named ease. The swatch also uses duration-200 and the theme class is cleared after 300ms, beside an unused --duration-* ladder of 100/150/250/400ms.

src/components/ThemeSwitcher.tsx:162 The swatch icon branches on theme.isLight and inlines rgba. First visit in the pre-paint script picks a random theme id, and globals.css interpolates background-color, color, border-color, and fill for 250ms on .theme-transitioning outside the reduced-motion block.
src/lib/brand-theme.ts:105 A raw rgba glow sits in the brand module next to the CSS variables. eslint-rules has no raw-color ban and no test reads themes.css to recompute contrast.
src/lib/brand-theme.ts:102 Accent class bundles consume Tailwind palette steps whose names encode the hue. dark-bronze rebinds --brand-cyan to #f59e0b, which these classes never see.

pairs.registryProposal: The three-state model is specified as explicit light, explicit dark, and follow-platform. It does not say what follow-platform selects when the vocabulary is many named themes rather than two.

pairs.evidence: src/hooks/useAnimatedNumber.ts:10 The count-up defaults to a raw 600ms and a local easeOut cubic, so the CSS duration ladder cannot retune it and reduced motion is a per-hook snap to the final value.

techniques.evidence: src/components/FloatingParticles.tsx:14 Particle fill colors are the midnight brand triplets written out for canvas. A theme rebind of --brand-cyan does not reach the draw loop.

src/components/FloatingParticles.tsx:11 The only axis in these files is a performance particle budget. Searched them for density, text-scale, font-scale, and prefers-contrast and found no spacing or type rebind.

src/hooks/useAnimatedNumber.ts:6 Easing is a local cubic named by curve shape, and the 600ms default is off the 100/150/250/400ms ladder. Reduced motion is a per-consumer useStillMotion or useReducedMotion branch, including ScrollMap duration-300 and particle durations of 5–13s.
src/hooks/useAnimationPause.ts:8 These modules pause and gate motion. A search of the listed files for data-theme, isLight, themeId, and prefers-color-scheme returned no hits.

src/components/ScrollMap.tsx:53 duration-300 is an off-ladder Tailwind step on a surface that also uses brand and muted roles. Nothing in eslint-rules fails a raw duration or a non-member timing value.
src/components/LazyMount.tsx:76 This uppercase label composes an arbitrary size and tracking value. The shared EYEBROW recipe is text-xs with tracking 0.14em, and this call site does not use it.

techniques.evidence: src/components/sections/how-role-path/Route.tsx:58 This 0.4s matches --duration-slow and TRANSITION_SLOW but is inlined, so a retune of either authority misses it. Ambience does read canvas ink back with getComputedStyle; this timing does not.

src/app/how/page.tsx:40 The page axis is a content role (developer, product-manager, enterprise). Searched these files for density, text-scale, font-scale, and prefers-contrast: no user appearance axis.
